title: Reddit said my combat looked cheap, so I rebuilt it. What I changed
author: ZeroFeels1
selftext:
Last week Reddit said my combat looked cheap and hard to read. So I rebuilt it for 0.2:



\- Brought back each unit's own AI-generated attack and death animations (I'd swapped them for code tilts, which looked worse), plus hit-stop and sparks on top.



\- Team colours, health bars on everyone, a hover card with hit chance.



\- One pixel scale everywhere, no mixels.



Workflow: sprites from PixelLab, code written with Claude Code in Godot, every change checked by screenshot.



Lesson: never replace a working AI animation with a code effect.
